Russia attacks Kyiv with missiles and drones, causing casualties

Russia launched a significant missile and drone attack on Ukraine's capital, Kyiv, resulting in multiple fatalities and injuries. The assault targeted residential areas and occurred ahead of a NATO summit. Russian officials stated that Ukraine's attacks would not go unanswered, while also claiming to have downed numerous air targets.
